actions.command: (ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null || netstat -tlnp 2>/dev/null) | grep -E '808[012]'; echo ---; for p in 8080 8081 8082; do echo "== $p =="; curl -s -m 3 http://127.0.0.1:$p/health; echo; done

actions.description: Check enabled state, other units referencing ports/role files, timers, failures
actions.command: systemctl is-enabled failover-proxy failover-replica failover-seed; echo ---; systemctl list-unit-files 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'failover|primary|8081'; echo ---; grep -rl '8081\|replica.role\|upstream' /etc/systemd/system/ 2>/dev/null | while read f; do echo "== $f"; done; echo ---; systemctl list-timers --all --no-pager 2>/dev/null | head -8; echo ---; systemctl --failed --no-pager | head -8; echo ---; ls /etc/systemd/system/ /etc/systemd/system/*.wants 2>/dev/null | head -40
